dashboard.label: SASP - ISE Authentication Activity
dashboard.description: Cisco ISE authentication patterns, user behavior baselines, and anomaly indicators for DFP model training and monitoring

search.query: index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth | dedup username | sort username | table username
index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth | dedup policy_set | sort policy_set | table policy_set
index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | stats count
index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" auth_result=FAIL | stats count
index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | stats dc(username) AS unique_users
index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | stats dc(calling_station_id) AS unique_devices

index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | stats count(eval(auth_result="FAIL")) AS failures count AS total | eval failure_rate=round((failures/total)*100,1)
index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | timechart count by auth_result
index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | timechart count by policy_set

panel.title: Authentication Heatmap — Hour of Day vs Day of Week

search.query: index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H") | eval day=strftime(_time,"%A") | stats count by day hour | xyseries day hour count

index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth policy_set="$policy_filter$" | stats count AS total count(eval(auth_result="FAIL")) AS failures dc(calling_station_id) AS devices dc(nas_ip) AS locations by username | eval failure_pct=round((failures/total)*100,1) | sort - failure_pct | head 15 | rename username AS "User", total AS "Total", failures AS "Failures", failure_pct AS "Fail %", devices AS "Devices", locations AS "Locations"

panel.title: Brute Force Indicator — Users with 10+ Failures in 5 min

search.query: index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth auth_result=FAIL username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | bin _time span=5m | stats count AS failures dc(calling_station_id) AS devices values(nas_ip) AS locations by _time username | where failures >= 10 | sort - _time | head 20 | rename _time AS "Window", username AS "User", failures AS "Failures (5m)", devices AS "Devices", locations AS "NAS IPs"

index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H")) | eval dow=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%w")) | where (hour >= 0 AND hour < 6) AND (dow >= 1 AND dow <= 5) | table _time username auth_result nas_ip calling_station_id policy_set | sort - _time | head 20 | rename _time AS "Time", username AS "User", auth_result AS "Result", nas_ip AS "NAS IP", calling_station_id AS "Device", policy_set AS "Policy"

index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" earliest=-7d@d latest=now | stats earliest(_time) AS first_seen latest(_time) AS last_seen count by username calling_station_id | where first_seen > relative_time(now(), "-24h@h") | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - first_seen | rename username AS "User", calling_station_id AS "Device MAC", first_seen AS "First Seen", last_seen AS "Last Seen", count AS "Auth Count"

panel.title: Rapid Location Changes — 2+ NAS IPs in 5 min

search.query: index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | bin _time span=5m | stats dc(nas_ip) AS unique_locations values(nas_ip) AS nas_ips by _time username | where unique_locations >= 2 | sort - _time | head 20 | rename _time AS "Window", username AS "User", unique_locations AS "Locations", nas_ips AS "NAS IPs"

panel.title: Credential Stuffing Indicator — Multiple Users from Same Device

search.query: index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth policy_set="$policy_filter$" | bin _time span=10m | stats dc(username) AS unique_users values(username) AS usernames count AS attempts by _time calling_station_id | where unique_users >= 3 | sort - _time | head 20 | rename _time AS "Window", calling_station_id AS "Device MAC", unique_users AS "Users", usernames AS "Usernames", attempts AS "Attempts"

panel.title: Service Account Anomalies — Unexpected NAS IP or High Failure

search.query: index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth policy_set="Service-Accounts" | stats count AS total count(eval(auth_result="FAIL")) AS failures dc(nas_ip) AS unique_nas values(nas_ip) AS nas_ips latest(_time) AS last_seen by username | eval fail_pct=round((failures/total)*100,1) | where unique_nas > 1 OR fail_pct > 1 | convert ctime(last_seen) | sort - fail_pct | rename username AS "Service Account", total AS "Total", failures AS "Failures", fail_pct AS "Fail %", unique_nas AS "NAS Count", nas_ips AS "NAS IPs", last_seen AS "Last Seen"
index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation model_name="ise-dfp" | stats count
index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation model_name="ise-dfp" | timechart avg(score) AS avg_score max(score) AS max_score
index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation model_name="ise-dfp" username="$username_filter$" | stats count by username | sort - count | head 15

index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation model_name="ise-dfp" | table timestamp username score top_features severity calling_station_id source_ip report_summary | sort - timestamp | head 20 | rename timestamp AS "Time", username AS "User", score AS "Score", top_features AS "Top Factors", severity AS "Severity", calling_station_id AS "Device", source_ip AS "NAS IP", report_summary AS "Description"

panel.title: Cross-Model Correlated Alerts — Same Source IP in Multiple Models (30 min window)

search.query: index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation (model_name="ise-dfp" OR model_name="netflow-anomaly") | bin _time span=30m | stats dc(model_name) AS model_count values(model_name) AS models values(username) AS users max(score) AS max_score latest(top_features) AS top_factors by _time source_ip | where model_count > 1 | sort - _time | head 20 | rename _time AS "Window", source_ip AS "Source IP", models AS "Alert Types", users AS "Users", max_score AS "Max Score", top_factors AS "Top Factors"

index=sasp_investigations sourcetype=sasp:investigation | eval alert_type=case(model_name="ise-dfp", "ISE DFP", model_name="netflow-anomaly", "NetFlow", model_name="abp-nvsmi", "GPU ABP", model_name="sid-minibert", "Syslog SID", 1=1, model_name) | timechart count by alert_type
index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth _anomaly_label=* | stats count by _anomaly_label | rename _anomaly_label AS "Scenario"
index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | stats count by auth_type | rename auth_type AS "Auth Type"
index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | stats count by nas_port_type | rename nas_port_type AS "Port Type"

index=sasp_ise sourcetype=sasp:ise_auth username="$username_filter$" policy_set="$policy_filter$" | table _time username auth_result auth_type nas_ip calling_station_id policy_set nas_port_type session_id _anomaly_label | sort - _time | head 100 | rename _time AS "Time", username AS "User", auth_result AS "Result", auth_type AS "Auth Type", nas_ip AS "NAS IP", calling_station_id AS "Device MAC", policy_set AS "Policy", nas_port_type AS "Port Type", session_id AS "Session", _anomaly_label AS "Anomaly Label"
